name: Bone Bonanza

features.name: Level-based free spins
features.description: Levels raise the multiplier as you progress.

features.name: Collection goal
features.description: Wins with new low-paying symbols advance the level.

review:
Skeletons on the Bonanza engine, with a clever twist in free spins: levels. The higher your level, the bigger your multiplier.

You level up by landing wins with low-paying symbols that haven't paid yet that round – so you end up watching every symbol and ticking them off like a collection. It gives the bonus a real goal. High volatility, a 14,134x max and 96% RTP. Free spins about once every 332 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 332 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
